COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
UKHC010125852026
WPSS/1915/2026
Bharat Ram Arya
--Petitioner
 Versus
State Of Uttarakhand & others
--Respondent
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Himanshu Bisht, learned counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. Mr. Narayan Dutt, learned Standing Counsel for the 
State.
3. Mr. D.C.S. Rawat, learned counsel for respondent 
no.2.
4. By means of present writ petition, petitioner has 
sought the following reliefs:-
“(a) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus 
directing the respondents to grant the petitioner the benefit of 
Second ACP with effect from 23.05.2012 and Third ACP with effect 
from 23.05.2022 in accordance with the decision of the Screening 
Committee dated 12.12.2023;
(b) Issue a writ, order or direction directing the respondents to fix 
the petitioner’s pay by granting Grade Pay of Rs.2800 w.e.f. 
23.05.2012 and Grade Pay of Rs.4200 w.e.f. 23.05.2022;
(c) Issue a writ, order or direction directing the respondents to pay 
all consequential arrears and service benefits arising therefrom 
together with interest at such rate as this Hon’ble Court deems fit 
and proper;
(d) Issue a writ, order or direction directing the respondents to 
extend uniform treatment and financial upgradation benefits to the 
petitioner at par with similarly situated employees.”
5. Issue notice to the respondent no.3, returnable within 
six weeks.
6. Steps to be taken within three days.
7. Counter affidavit(s) be filed within six weeks.
8. List on 22.09.2026.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
24.07.2026 AK

4. Misc. Application (IA No.1 of 2026) is allowed.
